##### Project general facts

Athlon by Aldar is the first community in the city designed to make movement a natural part of everyday life, created by Aldar in partnership with Dubai Holding. Developed around active design principles with leading wellbeing experts and athletes, it seamlessly merges walking and cycling loops with lush green parks and social spaces across nine residential clusters. The community offers luxury four-bedroom townhouses and four-, five- and six-bedroom standard and premium villas, rising from a ground floor to one or two upper floors.

Amenities turn the whole community into a playground. A signature clubhouse welcomes residents at the entrance, complemented by several clubhouses and fitness nodes throughout. A trail-running loop, a family-friendly loop and a cycling loop connecting to a long-distance desert cycling track sit alongside a pump track, padel, basketball and multi-use courts, a skate park, rock climbing, a yoga platform, a meditation deck, a cinema lawn, splash pads, family and lap pools, table tennis and play parks, together with fitness and wellness classes for adults and kids.

Homes are purposefully designed to be part of a dynamic living experience, with bright, generous layouts, natural lighting and a seamless flow between indoor spaces and private gardens. Sustainability is central to the design, with energy and water efficient systems, photovoltaic panels, electric vehicle charging, smart irrigation and native landscaping. Smart community features include digital amenity booking, access control and integrated security. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Arabian Ranches is a collection of established family communities in Dubailand, set within one of the largest green spaces in Dubai and surrounded by desert landscapes, parks and golf courses. The area offers a calm suburban lifestyle with schools, nurseries, clinics, community centres and supermarkets, while the Al Qudra cycling track and desert trails provide endless options for outdoor activity for residents of all ages.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road and Al Qudra Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai International Airport, Jumeirah Beach, Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are within comfortable driving distance, while Global Village, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Miracle Garden and Arabian Ranches Golf Club are a short drive away from home, keeping leisure, shopping and dining close at hand.

Arabian Ranches is one of Dubai's most popular freehold villa destinations, with strong demand from families seeking space, greenery and a community lifestyle. A unique active-living concept, LEED Platinum pre-certification and the backing of two leading developers set the community apart. Limited supply of large villas in master-planned communities supports steady rental demand and long-term capital growth for owners and investors.
